title: Write a first message to a lead
summary: A first message to one lead, written for you to read and send yourself.

asks.label: What do you know about them?

text: Write a first message to [lead]. Here is what I know about them: [about]. Keep it short and friendly, in our company's voice, and say why we are getting in touch. Use only what I have told you and what is in the company's files; do not invent facts about them. Do not send anything. I will read it and send it myself.
